Script.name: layout
Script.script:
-- The right-hand column: chat tabs on top, then the gauges, the map, the info -- panel and the command buttons. Built once; dl.ui.render() refills it.
local GAUGE_H = 20 local GAUGES_H = 4 * (GAUGE_H + 2) local TABS_H = 24 local CHAT_PCT = 28 local MAP_PCT = 30 local BUTTONS_H = 6 * 26
local function consoleStyle(console) console:setColor(dl.colors.bg) console:setFontSize(math.max(getFontSize() - 1, 8)) console:enableAutoWrap() end
local function gauge(name, y, r, g, b) local gg = Geyser.Gauge:new({ name = "dl." .. name, x = 4, y = y, width = "100%-8", height = GAUGE_H, }, dl.ui.root) gg:setColor(r, g, b) gg.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: #201a2c; border-radius: 3px;") gg.text:setStyleSheet("color: white; qproperty-alignment: 'AlignCenter';") return gg end
function dl.ui.applyBorder() if dl.settings.hidden or not dl.ui.root then setBorderRight(0) return end local w = getMainWindowSize() setBorderRight(math.floor(w * dl.settings.width / 100)) end
function dl.ui.build() if dl.ui.root then return end local w = dl.settings.width
dl.ui.root = Geyser.Container:new({ name = "dl.root", x = -w .. "%", y = 0, width = w .. "%", height = "100%", })
dl.ui.tabBar = Geyser.HBox:new({ name = "dl.tabBar", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = TABS_H, }, dl.ui.root)
dl.ui.chatBox = Geyser.Container:new({ name = "dl.chatBox", x = 0, y = TABS_H, width = "100%", height = CHAT_PCT .. "%-" .. TABS_H, }, dl.ui.root)
local gy = CHAT_PCT .. "%+" dl.ui.hp = gauge("hp", gy .. 2, 170, 30, 30) dl.ui.mana = gauge("mana", gy .. (2 + GAUGE_H + 2), 40, 70, 190) dl.ui.move = gauge("move", gy .. (2 + 2 * (GAUGE_H + 2)), 40, 150, 60) dl.ui.enemy = gauge("enemy", gy .. (2 + 3 * (GAUGE_H + 2)), 200, 120, 30)
dl.ui.map = Geyser.Mapper:new({ name = "dl.map", x = 0, y = gy .. (GAUGES_H + 4), width = "100%", height = MAP_PCT .. "%", }, dl.ui.root)
dl.ui.info = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "dl.info", x = 0, y = (CHAT_PCT + MAP_PCT) .. "%+" .. (GAUGES_H + 6), width = "100%", height = (100 - CHAT_PCT - MAP_PCT) .. "%-" .. (GAUGES_H + 6 + BUTTONS_H), }, dl.ui.root) consoleStyle(dl.ui.info)
dl.ui.buttonBox = Geyser.Container:new({ name = "dl.buttons", x = 0, y = -BUTTONS_H, width = "100%", height = BUTTONS_H, }, dl.ui.root)
dl.chat.build()
if dl.settings.hidden then dl.ui.root:hide() end dl.ui.applyBorder() end
function dl.ui.consoleStyle(console) consoleStyle(console) end
function dl.ui.setHidden(hidden) dl.settings.hidden = hidden dl.saveSettings() if not dl.ui.root then return end if hidden then dl.ui.root:hide() else dl.ui.root:show() dl.ui.render() end dl.ui.applyBorder() end
function dl.ui.setWidth(pct) dl.settings.width = pct dl.saveSettings() if not dl.ui.root then return end dl.ui.root:move(-pct .. "%", 0) dl.ui.root:resize(pct .. "%", "100%") dl.ui.applyBorder() end
function dl.ui.destroy() if dl.ui.root then dl.ui.root:hide() end setBorderRight(0) -- A reinstall (every package update) runs the scripts again and must build -- a fresh panel instead of finding this hidden one. dl.ui.root = nil dl.ui.buttons = {} dl.ui.buttonSig = nil end
function dl.ui.updateVitals() if not dl.ui.root then return end local p = dl.prompt local function set(g, cur, max, key) cur = tonumber(cur) or 0 max = tonumber(max) or 0 if max <= 0 then max = 1 end g:setValue(math.max(cur, 0), max, string.format("%s %d/%d", dl.t(key), cur, max)) end set(dl.ui.hp, p.hit, p.max_hit, "st.health") set(dl.ui.mana, p.mana, p.max_mana, "st.mana") set(dl.ui.move, p.move, p.max_move, "st.moves")
-- prompt.fight is the enemy's health in percent, 0 when not fighting. local fight = tonumber(p.fight) or 0 if fight > 0 then dl.ui.enemy:show() dl.ui.enemy:setValue(fight, 100, string.format("%s %d%%", dl.t("st.enemy"), fight)) else dl.ui.enemy:hide() end end

Script.name: panel
Script.script:
-- The info panel: the same blocks the web client shows, in the same order, -- redrawn from dl.prompt after every prompt.
local C = dl.colors local has = dl.has
-- Who panel race and clan names, keyed by the short codes the server sends. -- Same table as mudjs windowletsConstants.js. local RACE_NAMES = { ar = { en = "Arial", ru = "Ариал", ua = "Аріал" }, ce = { en = "Centa", ru = "Кентавр", ua = "Кентавр" }, cl = { en = "ClGia", ru = "ОбВелик", ua = "ХмВелет" }, da = { en = "D-Elf", ru = "ТемЭльф", ua = "ТемЕльф" }, dr = { en = "Drow", ru = "Дроу", ua = "Дроу" }, du = { en = "Duerg", ru = "Дуэргар", ua = "Дуергар" }, dw = { en = "Dwarf", ru = "Дварф", ua = "Дварф" }, el = { en = "Elf", ru = "Эльф", ua = "Ельф" }, fa = { en = "Faery", ru = "Фея", ua = "Фея" }, fe = { en = "Felar", ru = "Фелар", ua = "Фелар" }, fi = { en = "FiGia", ru = "ОгВелик", ua = "ВгВелет" }, fr = { en = "FrGia", ru = "ИнВелик", ua = "КрВелет" }, gi = { en = "Githy", ru = "Гитианк", ua = "Гітіанки" }, gn = { en = "Gnome", ru = "Гном", ua = "Гном" }, ha = { en = "H-Elf", ru = "ПолЭльф", ua = "НапЕльф" }, ho = { en = "Hobbi", ru = "Хоббит", ua = "Гобіт" }, hu = { en = "Human", ru = "Человек", ua = "Людина" }, ke = { en = "Kendr", ru = "Кендер", ua = "Кендер" }, ma = { en = "Mawg", ru = "Чес", ua = "Псюрень" }, ro = { en = "Rocks", ru = "Роксир", ua = "Роксір" }, sa = { en = "Satyr", ru = "Сатир", ua = "Сатир" }, st = { en = "StGia", ru = "ШтВелик", ua = "ШтВелет" }, sv = { en = "Svirf", ru = "Свирф", ua = "Свірф" }, tr = { en = "Troll", ru = "Тролль", ua = "Троль" }, ur = { en = "Urkhi", ru = "Урукха", ua = "Урукхай" }, }
local CLAN_NAMES = { a = { en = "Artificers", ru = "Артель", ua = "Артіль" }, b = { en = "Fury", ru = "Ярости", ua = "Ярості" }, c = { en = "Chaos", ru = "Хаос", ua = "Хаос" }, e = { en = "Exiles", ru = "Изгои", ua = "Ізгої" }, f = { en = "Flowers", ru = "Цветы", ua = "Квіти" }, g = { en = "Ghosts", ru = "Призраки", ua = "Привиди" }, i = { en = "Invaders", ru = "Захватчики", ua = "Загарбники" }, k = { en = "Knights", ru = "Рыцари", ua = "Лицарі" }, l = { en = "Lions", ru = "Львы", ua = "Леви" }, o = { en = "Loners", ru = "Одиночки", ua = "Одинаки" }, r = { en = "Rulers", ru = "Правители", ua = "Правителі" }, s = { en = "Shalafi", ru = "Шалафи", ua = "Шалафі" }, }
local function localName(tbl, code) local e = tbl[code] if not e then return code or "" end return e[dl.lang()] or e.en end
-- Affect families in the web order: curses first, bad news leads. local AFFECT_FAMILIES = { "mal", "pro", "det", "trv", "enh", "cln" }
local function out(text, color) dl.ui.info:hecho((color or C.text) .. text) end
-- Sections are separated by a blank line; the first one starts at the top. local firstSection = true
local function title(text) if not firstSection then out("\n") end firstSection = false out(text .. "\n", C.title) end
local function pad(s, n) s = tostring(s or "") local len = utf8.len(s) or #s if len >= n then return s end return s .. string.rep(" ", n - len) end
local function location(p) if not (has(p.zone) or has(p.room)) then return end title(dl.t("loc.title")) if has(p.zone) then out(p.zone .. "\n", C.zone) end if has(p.room) then out(p.room .. "\n", C.room) end local ex = p.exits if type(ex) == "table" then -- e: open exits, h: closed ones, as lowercase English letters. -- l: which letters to draw, "r" for Russian ones. local dirs = { { "n", "N", "С" }, { "e", "E", "В" }, { "s", "S", "Ю" }, { "w", "W", "З" }, { "d", "D", "О" }, { "u", "U", "П" } } out(dl.t("loc.exits") .. " ") for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do local letter = ex.l == "r" and d[3] or d[2] if string.find(ex.h or "", d[1], 1, true) then out(letter .. " ", C.dim) elseif string.find(ex.e or "", d[1], 1, true) then out(letter .. " ", C.room) else out("· ", C.dim) end end out("\n") end if type(p.sect) == "table" and has(p.sect.n) then out(p.sect.n .. "\n", C.dim) end end
local function timeWeather(p) local t, d, w = p.time, p.date, p.w if type(t) ~= "table" and type(d) ~= "table" and type(w) ~= "table" then return end title(dl.t("tw.title")) if type(t) == "table" then out(string.format("%s %s", t.h or "", t.tod or "")) if has(t.l) then out(", " .. t.l) end out("\n") end if type(d) == "table" then out(string.format("%s / %s", d.d or "", d.m or "")) if has(d.s) then out(" / " .. d.s) end out("\n") end if type(w) == "table" and has(w.m) then out(w.m .. "\n") end end
local function quests(p) -- aq: area quest, t = title, i = current step. if type(p.aq) == "table" then title(p.aq.t or "") out((p.aq.i or "") .. "\n", "#d0b040") end -- q: questor task, t = minutes left, i = what to do. if type(p.q) == "table" then title(string.format("%s %s %s", dl.t("qst.title"), p.q.t or "", dl.t("qst.min"))) out((p.q.i or "") .. "\n") end end
local function group(p) local g = p.group -- Solo players get only the leader line; the web hides the block then too. if type(g) ~= "table" or (g.pc == nil and g.npc == nil) then return end title(dl.t("grp.title") .. " " .. (g.ln or "")) local function row(m) out(pad(m.sees, 12) .. pad(m.level, 4)) out(pad((m.health or "?") .. "%", 6), dl.ansi[tostring(m.hit_clr)] or C.text) out(tostring(m.tnl or "") .. "\n", C.dim) end if type(g.leader) == "table" then row(g.leader) end for _, list in ipairs({ g.pc, g.npc }) do if type(list) == "table" then for _, m in ipairs(list) do row(m) end end end end
local function affects(p) local items = {} for _, fam in ipairs(AFFECT_FAMILIES) do if type(p[fam]) == "table" then for _, a in ipairs(p[fam]) do items[#items + 1] = { n = a.n, d = tonumber(a.d), curse = fam == "mal" } end end end if #items == 0 then return end -- Curses first, then soonest to expire; permanent ones (d < 0) last. local function rank(a) if a.d == nil or a.d < 0 then return math.huge end return a.d end table.sort(items, function(a, b) if a.curse ~= b.curse then return a.curse end return rank(a) < rank(b) end) title(dl.t("aff.title")) for i, a in ipairs(items) do local color = dl.ansi["2"] if a.curse then color = dl.ansi["1"] elseif a.d ~= nil and a.d < 0 then color = dl.ansi["6"] elseif a.d ~= nil and a.d <= 1 then color = dl.ansi["3"] end out(a.n or "?", color) out(i < #items and " " or "\n") end end
local function stats(p) local p1, p2 = p.p1, p.p2 if type(p1) ~= "table" and type(p2) ~= "table" then return end title(dl.t("par.title")) if type(p1) == "table" and type(p1.ps) == "table" then local keys = { "str", "int", "wis", "dex", "con", "cha" } for i, k in ipairs(keys) do out(dl.t("par." .. k) .. " ", C.dim) out(tostring(p1.ps[i] or "?")) out("(" .. tostring((p1.cs or {})[i] or "?") .. ")", C.dim) out(i % 3 == 0 and "\n" or " ") end end if type(p2) == "table" then for _, k in ipairs({ { "hit", "h" }, { "dam", "d" }, { "ac", "a" }, { "save", "s" } }) do out(dl.t("par." .. k[1]) .. " ", C.dim) out(tostring(p2[k[2]] or "?") .. " ") end out("\n") end end
-- How many more lines fit in the panel. A console that overflows sits -- scrolled to its bottom and hides the top blocks, so the who list, the only -- block that grows with the world, gets whatever room is left. local function freeLines() local _, lineHeight = calcFontSize("dl.info") if not lineHeight or lineHeight <= 0 then return 1000 end local fits = math.floor(dl.ui.info:get_height() / lineHeight) return fits - getLineCount("dl.info") end
local function who(p, room) local w = p.who if type(w) ~= "table" or type(w.p) ~= "table" then return end -- Blank separator and title take two lines; keep one for the "+N" line. local rows = #w.p if rows > room - 2 then rows = math.max(room - 3, 0) end title(string.format("%s (%s)", dl.t("who.title"), w.t or #w.p)) for i, pl in ipairs(w.p) do if i > rows then out(string.format("+%d\n", #w.p - rows), C.dim) break end local name = pl.n or "?" dl.ui.info:hechoLink(C.room .. pad(name, 13), function() send("whois " .. name, true) end, "whois " .. name, true) out(pad(localName(RACE_NAMES, pl.r), 9), C.dim) if pl.cn and pl.cn ~= "n" then out(localName(CLAN_NAMES, pl.cn)) end out("\n") end end
function dl.ui.renderInfo() if not dl.ui.info or dl.settings.hidden then return end local p = dl.prompt dl.ui.info:clear() firstSection = true location(p) timeWeather(p) quests(p) group(p) affects(p) stats(p) who(p, freeLines()) end

Script.name: chat
Script.script:
-- Chat tabs fed by Comm.Channel.Text. Every line also stays in the main -- window as the game printed it; the tabs are a copy you can scroll back in.
dl.chat = dl.chat or {}
local TABS = { "all", "room", "personal", "group", "world" }
-- The server's coarse channel buckets (chatframe.h), folded into five tabs. local KIND_TO_TAB = { room = "room", mob = "room", quest = "room", personal = "personal", group = "group", world = "world", area = "world", race = "world", }
local function tabStyle(label, active, unread) local bg = active and "#3a2f52" or "#1c1726" local fg = unread and "#ffff55" or (active and "white" or "#a090c0") label:setStyleSheet(string.format( "background-color: %s; color: %s; border: 1px solid #3a2f52; border-radius: 3px;", bg, fg)) end
local function tabCaption(tab) local caption = dl.t("tab." .. tab) if dl.chat.unread[tab] then caption = caption .. " *" end return "<center>" .. caption .. "</center>" end
function dl.chat.refreshTabs() for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do local label = dl.chat.labels[tab] if label then label:echo(tabCaption(tab)) tabStyle(label, tab == dl.chat.active, dl.chat.unread[tab]) end end end
function dl.chat.switch(tab) dl.chat.active = tab dl.chat.unread[tab] = nil for _, t in ipairs(TABS) do if t == tab then dl.chat.consoles[t]:show() else dl.chat.consoles[t]:hide() end end dl.chat.refreshTabs() end
function dl.chat.build() dl.chat.labels = {} dl.chat.consoles = {} dl.chat.unread = {} for _, tab in ipairs(TABS) do local label = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "dl.tab." .. tab }, dl.ui.tabBar) label:setClickCallback(function() dl.chat.switch(tab) end) dl.chat.labels[tab] = label
local console = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "dl.chat." .. tab, x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%", }, dl.ui.chatBox) dl.ui.consoleStyle(console) dl.chat.consoles[tab] = console end dl.chat.switch("all") end
local function put(tab, line) local console = dl.chat.consoles[tab] if not console then return end console:decho(line) if tab ~= dl.chat.active then dl.chat.unread[tab] = true end end
function dl.chat.onText() local msg = gmcp.Comm and gmcp.Comm.Channel and gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text if type(msg) ~= "table" or not dl.chat.consoles then return end local text = msg.text or "" if text == "" then return end if not text:ends("\n") then text = text .. "\n" end local stamp = "" if tonumber(msg.at) then stamp = "<112,112,112>" .. os.date("%H:%M ", tonumber(msg.at)) end local line = stamp .. ansi2decho(text)
put("all", line) local tab = KIND_TO_TAB[msg.kind or ""] if tab then put(tab, line) end dl.chat.refreshTabs() end

Script.name: buttons
events
Script.script:
-- Wiring: GMCP events, install/uninstall, and the `dl` command.
local OWNER = "dreamland"
function dl.ui.render() dl.ui.updateVitals() dl.ui.renderInfo() dl.ui.renderButtons() end
-- The server sends only the prompt fields that changed, like it does for the -- web client, so merge them into what we already have. function dl.onPrompt() local p = gmcp.Dreamland and gmcp.Dreamland.Prompt if type(p) ~= "table" then return end local oldLang = dl.prompt.lang for k, v in pairs(p) do dl.prompt[k] = v end if not dl.ui.root then dl.ui.build() end if dl.prompt.lang ~= oldLang and dl.chat.refreshTabs then dl.chat.refreshTabs() dl.ui.buttonSig = nil end dl.ui.render() end
-- Mudlet installs its generic mapper on every new profile. It builds the map -- from game text and fights our GMCP mapper over the same rooms, so remove -- it -- unless the player already drew a map with it. function dl.quietGenericMapper() if not table.contains(getPackages(), "generic_mapper") then return end if dl.map.hasForeignRooms() then return end uninstallPackage("generic_mapper") end
-- The 2019 package drew a bottom bar, a mapper and a chat window. When it is -- upgraded in a running session its windows outlive its scripts, so hide them. local OLD_WINDOWS = { "bottompanel", "dhb.healthbox", "dhb.ui.mapchat", "dhb.ui.chat", "dhb.ui.mapper", "DemonChatTabs" }
function dl.hideOldPackage() local hidden = false for _, name in ipairs(OLD_WINDOWS) do local w = Geyser.windowList[name] if w then w:hide() hidden = true end end if hidden then setBorderBottom(0) end end
function dl.start() dl.loadSettings() dl.hideOldPackage() deleteAllNamedEventHandlers(OWNER) registerNamedEventHandler(OWNER, "prompt", "gmcp.Dreamland.Prompt", dl.onPrompt) registerNamedEventHandler(OWNER, "chat", "gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text", dl.chat.onText) registerNamedEventHandler(OWNER, "room", "gmcp.Room.Info", function() dl.map.onRoomInfo() end) registerNamedEventHandler(OWNER, "mapDone", "sysDownloadDone", function(...) dl.map.onDownloadDone(...) end) registerNamedEventHandler(OWNER, "mapError", "sysDownloadError", function(...) dl.map.onDownloadError(...) end) registerNamedEventHandler(OWNER, "resize", "sysWindowResizeEvent", function() dl.ui.applyBorder() end) registerNamedEventHandler(OWNER, "uninstall", "sysUninstallPackage", function(_, name) if name == "Dreamland" then dl.ui.destroy() deleteAllNamedEventHandlers(OWNER) end end) tempTimer(1, dl.quietGenericMapper) end
function dl.help() cecho("\n<orchid>DreamLand UI " .. dl.version .. "<reset>\n" .. " dl hide -- hide the side panel (the game text stays as it is)\n" .. " dl show -- show it again\n" .. " dl width <N> -- panel width, 15 to 60 percent of the window\n") end
function dl.command(args) args = (args or ""):trim() local width = args:match("^width%s+(%d+)$") if args == "hide" then dl.ui.setHidden(true) elseif args == "show" then dl.ui.setHidden(false) elseif width then dl.ui.setWidth(math.max(15, math.min(60, tonumber(width)))) else dl.help() end end
dl.start()

Script.name: mapper
Script.script:
-- Mapper: draws the map from GMCP Room.Info as the player walks. -- -- Room.Info carries the room vnum, its name and area in the player's -- language, the exits as {dir = vnum} and the zone's web map URL, whose file -- name ("midgaard") is the stable key of the area. The downloadable starter -- map (Client.Map) is built by tools/build_map.lua with these same functions, -- so rooms found while walking and rooms from the file line up. dl.map = dl.map or {}
local DELTA = { n = { 0, 1, 0 }, e = { 1, 0, 0 }, s = { 0, -1, 0 }, w = { -1, 0, 0 }, u = { 0, 0, 1 }, d = { 0, 0, -1 }, }
-- "https://dreamland.rocks/maps/midgaard.html" -> "midgaard" function dl.map.areaKey(info) local key = type(info.map) == "string" and info.map:match("([^/]+)%.html$") return key or info.area or "unknown" end
local function findArea(key) for _, id in pairs(getAreaTable()) do if getAreaUserData(id, "dl.key") == key then return id end end end
function dl.map.areaId(key, name) local id = findArea(key) if not id then id = addAreaName(name ~= "" and name or key) if not id or id < 0 then -- The name is taken by an area from another source: keep it unique. id = addAreaName((name ~= "" and name or key) .. " (" .. key .. ")") end setAreaUserData(id, "dl.key", key) elseif name ~= "" and getRoomAreaName(id) ~= name then -- The player switched the game language: follow it. setAreaName(id, name) end return id end
-- Exits are remembered per room so that a room met later can find the -- neighbour that points at it. local function savedExits(id) local raw = getRoomUserData(id, "dl.exits") if raw == nil or raw == "" then return {} end local ok, t = pcall(yajl.to_value, raw) return ok and type(t) == "table" and t or {} end
-- Pick coordinates next to a room of the same area that is already placed, -- either one this room leads to or one that leads here. local function place(num, areaId, exits) for dir, target in pairs(exits) do local dlt = DELTA[dir] if dlt and roomExists(target) and getRoomArea(target) == areaId then local x, y, z = getRoomCoordinates(target) return x - dlt[1], y - dlt[2], z - dlt[3] end end for _, other in pairs(getAreaRooms(areaId) or {}) do for dir, target in pairs(savedExits(other)) do local dlt = DELTA[dir] if dlt and tonumber(target) == num then local x, y, z = getRoomCoordinates(other) return x + dlt[1], y + dlt[2], z + dlt[3] end end end -- Nothing to hang on to: start a fresh patch to the right of the area. local maxX for _, other in pairs(getAreaRooms(areaId) or {}) do local x = getRoomCoordinates(other) if not maxX or x > maxX then maxX = x end end return maxX and maxX + 5 or 0, 0, 0 end
-- Add or refresh one room. Returns its id. function dl.map.addRoom(info) local num = tonumber(info.num) if not num then return end local exits = {} for dir, target in pairs(info.exits or {}) do exits[dir] = tonumber(target) end local areaId = dl.map.areaId(dl.map.areaKey(info), info.area or "")
if not roomExists(num) then addRoom(num) setRoomArea(num, areaId) setRoomCoordinates(num, place(num, areaId, exits)) end if info.name and info.name ~= "" then setRoomName(num, info.name) end
-- Exits only ever get added: the server hides the ones the player cannot -- see right now (darkness, closed hidden doors), which is not a removal. local known = savedExits(num) for dir, target in pairs(exits) do known[dir] = target if roomExists(target) then setExitStub(num, dir, false) setExit(num, target, dir) else setExitStub(num, dir, true) end end setRoomUserData(num, "dl.exits", yajl.to_string(known))
-- Link the rooms that were waiting for this one behind a stub. for dir, target in pairs(exits) do if roomExists(target) then for backDir, backTarget in pairs(savedExits(target)) do if tonumber(backTarget) == num then setExitStub(target, backDir, false) setExit(target, num, backDir) end end end end return num end
-- Mudlet only registers the Client.Map URL and offers a download button on an -- empty map; the first room drawn here would hide that button for good. So on -- an empty map fetch the starter map first and draw the room once it is in. local MAP_FILE = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/dreamland_map.dat"
local function mapIsEmpty() return next(getRooms() or {}) == nil end
local function mapUrl() local m = gmcp.Client and gmcp.Client.Map return type(m) == "table" and m.url or nil end
local function drawPending() local info = dl.map.pending dl.map.pending = nil if info then local num = dl.map.addRoom(info) if num then centerview(num) end end end
function dl.map.onRoomInfo() local info = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if type(info) ~= "table" then return end if dl.map.pending then -- Still downloading: draw only the latest room once the map is in. dl.map.pending = info return end if not dl.map.downloadTried and mapIsEmpty() and mapUrl() then dl.map.downloadTried = true dl.map.pending = info downloadFile(MAP_FILE, mapUrl()) -- If neither download event ever comes, map from here on anyway. tempTimer(30, drawPending) return end local num = dl.map.addRoom(info) if num then centerview(num) end end
function dl.map.onDownloadDone(_, file) if file ~= MAP_FILE then return end -- Only load into a map that is still empty: never overwrite one the -- player has started meanwhile. if mapIsEmpty() then loadMap(MAP_FILE) end drawPending() end
function dl.map.onDownloadError(_, err, file) if file ~= MAP_FILE and not tostring(err):find(MAP_FILE, 1, true) then return end drawPending() end
-- True when the map holds rooms that this mapper did not draw, i.e. the -- player mapped with something else. function dl.map.hasForeignRooms() for id in pairs(getRooms() or {}) do local area = getRoomArea(id) if not area or getAreaUserData(area, "dl.key") == "" then return true end end return false end
